the development of an innovative method to improve the quality of breast tomosynthesis (BT) images.

the development of a new imaging modality called breast tomosynthesis (BT).
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
tomosynthesis is a new and potentially valuable imaging modality for breast cancer screening.
breast tomosynthesis provides a better image quality than conventional mammography, but it is not clear whether the improvement is clinically meaningful.
tomosynthesis is not a panacea, and that the benefits and limitations of tomosynthesis should be considered in relation to the clinical question being addressed.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that
we have demonstrated that a breast tomosynthesis system can produce images that are of comparable diagnostic quality to that of mammography.
the quality of breast tomosynthesis images depends strongly on the geometric factors of the system, and that this dependence is more pronounced than for mammography.
the image quality in breast tomosyn-thesis is highly dependent on the geometric parameters of the system.
The main takeaway from our work is that
breast tomosynthesis can be used to improve the detection of microcalcifications in the breast.

the image quality of tomosynthesis is highly dependent on the geometric factors of the system, and the image quality of the tomosynthesis system can be significantly improved by reducing the distance between the source and detector and the distance between the detector and the breast.
breast tomosynthesis is a promising technology for the early detection and diagnosis of breast cancer.
